svg.text: Caraiani–Newton: the roadmaps it needs, in upstream order

Tier 1 (closest to Mathlib and Tau Ceti) at the bottom; each box depends only on boxes in lower tiers. A box with several roadmaps is a bundle: each keeps its own package, and they go to Tau Ceti together in one pull request.

Lines show essential dependencies only (transitive reduction). The 61 stage links and 503 plan citations that point upward are not drawn: they move down. FoundationsAndLibraryIntegration (library bookkeeping, not packaged) is omitted.
current `top` label (tiers 1–2): being worked on now
